title: BackGuiner: Yomigaeru Yuushatachi: Kakusei-hen: Guiner Tensei
native_title: バックガイナー ～よみがえる勇者たち～ 覚醒編「ガイナー転生」
overview:
The wish will reach, because that is my truth.......

Special Mobile Unit, move out!!

Carefully crafted, captivating animation for both events and battles heightens this grand drama and stages the girls' battles in splendid fashion.

BackGuiner opens its story with the Awakening chapter. In the Tokyo of 2008, a giant robot rampages through the city and the army cannot stop it, while strange creatures of unknown origin attack the streets. On his way to school, the young hero is swept into the fight when a friend climbs into a wounded police pilot's armored robot, and soon he is helping a special mobile unit hold back the forces trying to conquer Earth - even if the girls of the squad often steal the spotlight from him. The story unfolds through animated events, conversations and turn-based tactical battles in which each unit has limited movement and a choice of attacks.

- First chapter of the BackGuiner story
- Animated event and battle scenes
- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Two discs

願いはとどく、それが僕の真実だから……。

特機隊、出動！！

イベント、戦闘と　こだわった魅力的なアニメーションがこの壮大なドラマを盛り上げ、彼女たちの戦いを華麗に演出
